description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMessageSignalMapper' which serves as a base for mapping signals related to message commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It includes methods for validating channels, constructing topic paths, extracting message subjects, status codes, headers, and enhancing payloads and headers for signals.

classes.name: AbstractMessageSignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common functionality for mapping signals related to message commands, including validation, topic path construction, and payload/header enhancement.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the channel is 'LIVE'; throws IllegalArgumentException otherwise.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs a topic path for the message command based on the thing ID and subject.

methods.name: extractSubject
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the message subject from the command.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the HTTP status code from the command.

methods.name: extractMessageHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method to extract message headers from the command.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload builder with message content, status code, and status from the command JSON.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Merges message headers with the command's Ditto headers, giving precedence to message headers.
